primitives.name: Offensiveness Index
primitives.verbatim_quote: Team actions: crosses, corners, shots, goal kicks, offsides (8 vars).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'s^H_{i,t,2}': 'Sum of player roles (defenders×1 + midfielders×2 + forwards×3)', 'active': 'Number of active players on pitch', 's^H_{i,t,3}': 'Dimensionless aggressiveness score (range 10/30 to 30/30)'}
primitives.assumptions: Formation ≈ coach decision; commentary coding is consistent; team FE absorbs persistent heterogeneity.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Convert offensive line pass attempts (vs rush attempts) into a comparable "aggressiveness" index using league-specific multipliers. GSE: Use early-down pass frequency relative to expected frequency as a quarterback/playcaller aggressiveness metric.
layer2.telemetry: Home advantage differential in the index between matched-away teams

primitives.name: Coach Adjustment Effect
primitives.verbatim_quote: Method / model Three outcome models: (1) OLS on home–away goal difference; (2) logit on home win; (3) ordered logit on home points (0/1/3) with proportional-odds testing via bootstrap-augmented Brant test.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'s^H_{final} - s^H_{initial}': 'Difference in offensiveness scores (dimensionless)', 'Δ_offense': 'Change in attacking intensity (units depend on scoring system)'}
primitives.assumptions: Coaches' in-game adjustments are captured by comparing starting vs ending formations; proportional odds holds.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Sensitive to lineup substitutions; singular at halftime (no adjustment possible)

layer2.mapping: GSI: Fourth-down conversion rate vs win-probability threshold provides a binary proxy for adjustment. GSE: Blitz percentage change from first half to second half captures defensive adaptation.
layer2.telemetry: Correlation between Δ_offense and home advantage in goal difference

primitives.name: Akaike Weighted Average
primitives.verbatim_quote: Selection: full subset search over block-nested candidates with AIC/BIC; Akaike-weight model averaging over top 2.5%/5% candidates (393/317/107 specs) with shrinkage estimator θ̃=Σw_l θ̂_l and Burnham–Anderson variance.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'w_l': 'Akaike weight (dimensionless, sum to 1 across models)', '\\hat{\\theta}_l': 'Estimate from model l (same units as parameter)', '\\tilde{\\theta}': 'Weighted-average estimate (same units as parameter)', 'Var(\\hat{\\theta})': 'Variance of the full-model estimate', 'Var(\\tilde{\\theta})': 'Total uncertainty accounting for model selection', 'BCa_interval': 'Bias-corrected accelerated confidence interval (empirical coverage)'}
primitives.assumptions: AIC/BIC criteria are valid; multiple models are nested within a larger set; model averaging reduces overfitting.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Instable when the top models have vastly different parameter estimates; singular when a single model dominates (w_max ~ 1)

layer2.mapping: GSI: Ensemble of predictive models (e.g., win probabilities from different machine-learning algorithms) are weighted by their out-of-sample performance. GSE: State-transition probabilities are averaged across similar game states to improve robustness.
layer2.telemetry: Reduction in coefficient variance compared to single best-model estimates
